title: Derived Hom from a semidualizing complex detects bounded coherent isomorphisms
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Work in its ordinary module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $R\operatorname{Hom}$ as the internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. Write $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A)$ for objects with bounded, finitely generated cohomology. Let $C\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A)$ and assume the scalar-action morphism $A\to R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,C)$ is an isomorphism. For every $Z\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A)$, the equality $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,Z)=0$ implies $Z=0$. Consequently, for any morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $X,Y\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A)$, if $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,f)$ is an isomorphism then $f$ is an isomorphism. No finite projective or injective dimension of $C$ is assumed.

source.place: Agent corollary of Tag 0BFR (complete Noetherian local rings have dualizing complexes) and Tag 0A7C (duality on coherent complexes, including unbounded coherent complexes), using more-algebra.tex Tags 0A6A (flat RHom base change), 0A65 (tensor-Hom adjunction), and derived Nakayama. Proof of the corollary is explained in report.md; it is not asserted to be the statement of Tag 0A7C.
